important_bug_found_and_fixed.bug: An early capability-impact implementation could have applied a calibrated-looking multiplier even when the capability itself was not runtime verified.
important_bug_found_and_fixed.fix: Capability row multipliers now enter the forecast only when both the capability runtime status and the impact receipt are verified.
important_bug_found_and_fixed.regression_test: Unverified capability with a fake VERIFIED impact object must leave FINAL_MODEL_FINE_TUNE capability_factor at 1.0 and must not move the forecast.

covered_invariants: baseline forecast resolves
owner-training conditional is explicit
partial stage progress moves progress forward and shortens forecast
verified accelerator shortens affected critical-path work
unverified accelerator is rejected and has zero forecast effect
new runtime-verified API/capability is auto-discovered
runtime-verified but uncalibrated API does not receive fictional ETA bonus
unverified API cannot alter ETA even when its file contains a fake calibrated impact
verified calibrated API changes only mapped rows
multiple provider accelerators do not blindly multiply; strongest single verified row factor wins
verified blocker/rework can move forecast later
hardware fallback date is parsed from the dated hardware entry rather than an unrelated capacity-state date
owner authorization toggles conditional state
completed future workspace advances forecast progress
verified elimination removes remaining effort and shortens scope
measured stage throughput outranks the engineering prior
capability-extension metadata can override stale registry status
irrelevant API remains visible but has no critical-path effect
new required scope can lower project-progress percentage and delay forecast
dependency cycle fails closed
status footer resolves both NEXT LEVEL and DOOMSDAY from the same dynamic state

test_environment.method: temporary repository fixtures with controlled program/capacity/capability/event mutations

limitations: These tests validate forecast logic, invariants and integration behavior, not the accuracy of current engineering priors.
Current stage priors remain low-confidence until real completion/throughput data accumulates.
Provider speedup factors remain 1.0 unless a real benchmark receipt verifies otherwise.
The GitHub Actions workflow is installed for ongoing regression execution; this receipt records the local deterministic test run performed during implementation.
